owned.description: Shared note preferences, persistence and emitted reading variables.
UI font and radius preference runtime outputs.
Component-local geometry, typography bindings and reading layout; no copied global scale.
Current sidebar, modal, menu, editor and content overlay stacking.
Shared breakpoint and current drawer/content layout.
Resolved current UI semantic colors and radius supplied to native surfaces.
Native capture and floating navigation shadow profiles in logical points; light opacity is 75% of the native dark baseline, with drawer progress applied by UIKit.
Native safe-area, system controls and platform text metrics.
Base UI floating positioner outputs consumed by current menus and popovers.

Independent card hover shadow and scale capabilities; collection cards and Preview links explicitly compose them, Elevation demonstrates shadow alone. Fine-pointer desktop only and reduced-motion aware.
Web mobile action hover, press and disabled feedback; selection, expanded state and keyboard focus remain owned by their controls.
Page-wide pointer versus keyboard input focus policy; grouped controls delegate the outline, and validation feedback stays independent.
